title: Ten four-side affine line codes with packed metric decoding

claims.statement: The explicit ten-block affine line code and its scalar decoder in proof.md for 1000 information bits on 2000 independent BSC(1/10) uses have uniform-message average block error at most 124756581460271469/125000000000000000.
The stated scalar bsc-ops-v1 decoder for the same affine line code executes at most the integer W=15392656 operations for every received word, with W<=2^(5969/250).

experiments.purpose: Recompute an exact sector of the local spectra. The final sector also calculates the full affine line spectrum and block error bound, and checks memory, packed metrics and exact operation exponent.
